# Palette

실제 색상은 css variable로 사용합니다.

## Atomic

<Demo 
  hideCode
  code={`'use client';
import { Box, FlexBox, Typography, lightOriginTheme } from '@wanteddev/wds';

const renderItem = (item, key) => {
  return (
    <>
      {Object.entries(item).map(([k, v]) => {
        if (typeof v === 'object') {
          return (
            <FlexBox
              flexWrap="wrap"
              key={k}
              gap="8px"
            >
              {renderItem(v, key ? key + '.' + k : k)}
            </FlexBox>
          );
        }

        return (
          <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="4px" key={k} sx={{ width: '75px' }}>
            <FlexBox
              sx={theme => ({
                border: \`1px solid \${theme.semantic.line.normal.neutral}\`,
                backgroundColor: v.toString().startsWith('#') ? v.toString() : undefined,
                boxShadow: v.toString().startsWith('#') ? undefined : v.toString(),
                height: '60px',
                borderRadius: '6px',
              })}
            />
            <Typography variant="caption2" weight="bold" align="center">
              {key ? key + '.' + k : k}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption2" weight="regular" align="center">
              {v.toString()}
            </Typography>
          </FlexBox>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

const Demo = () => {
  const atomic = (({
    common,
    neutral,
    coolNeutral,
    blue,
    red,
    green,
    orange,
    redOrange,
    lime,
    cyan,
    lightBlue,
    violet,
    purple,
    pink,
  }) => ({
    common,
    neutral,
    coolNeutral,
    blue,
    red,
    green,
    orange,
    redOrange,
    lime,
    cyan,
    lightBlue,
    violet,
    purple,
    pink,
  }))(lightOriginTheme.atomic);

  return (
    <FlexBox flexDirection="column" flex="1">
      <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="28px">
        {Object.entries(atomic).map(([title, value]) => {
          return (
            <FlexBox key={title} flexDirection="column" gap="12px">
              <Typography variant="headline1" weight="bold">
                {title}
              </Typography>

              <FlexBox
                flexWrap="wrap"
                gap="8px"
              >
                {renderItem(value)}
              </FlexBox>
            </FlexBox>
          );
        })}
      </FlexBox>
    </FlexBox>
  );
};

export default Demo;`}
/>

## Semantic

<Demo 
  hideCode
  code={`import { Box, FlexBox, Typography, lightOriginTheme, darkOriginTheme, useThemeControl } from '@wanteddev/wds';

const renderItem = (item, key) => {
  return (
    <>
      {Object.entries(item).map(([k, v]) => {
        if (typeof v === 'object') {
          return (
            <FlexBox
              flexWrap="wrap"
              key={k}
              gap="8px"
            >
              {renderItem(v, key ? key + '.' + k : k)}
            </FlexBox>
          );
        }

        return (
          <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="4px" key={k} sx={{ width: '75px' }}>
            <FlexBox
              sx={theme => ({
                border: \`1px solid \${theme.semantic.line.normal.neutral}\`,
                backgroundColor: v.toString().startsWith('#') ? v.toString() : undefined,
                boxShadow: v.toString().startsWith('#') ? undefined : v.toString(),
                height: '60px',
                borderRadius: '6px',
              })}
            />
            <Typography variant="caption2" weight="bold" align="center">
              {key ? key + '.' + k : k}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption2" weight="regular" align="center">
              {v.toString()}
            </Typography>
          </FlexBox>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

const Demo = () => {
  const { theme } = useThemeControl();

  const semantic = (theme === 'light' ? lightOriginTheme.semantic : darkOriginTheme.semantic);

  return (
    <FlexBox flexDirection="column" flex="1">
      <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="28px">
        {Object.entries(semantic).map(([title, value]) => {
          return (
            <FlexBox key={title} flexDirection="column" gap="12px">
              <Typography variant="headline1" weight="bold">
                {title}
              </Typography>

              <FlexBox
                flexWrap="wrap"
                gap="8px"
              >
                {renderItem(value)}
              </FlexBox>
            </FlexBox>
          );
        })}
      </FlexBox>
    </FlexBox>
  );
};

export default Demo;`}
/>
